$comment: The question crates/coder/src/runtime.rs sends before every turn, lifted out of the crate and given a name a row can pin. The wording is questions/program.json; the options are the programs in programs/ that this host would admit, which is what Runtime::select builds an option set from.

This set supersedes program-selection-v2: it adds the `review-runs` option the repository gained on 2026-09-23 (issue #9574), and nothing else changed. A new option is a new question, so it carries a new id rather than an edit to v2, whose measurement stays about v2. `run-suite` and `review-changes` are still not offered, for the reasons v2 gives.

This file is generated, not written. `cargo test -p coder --test suite_questions -- --ignored --nocapture print_wire_selection` prints it, and `the_selection_question_is_the_production_text` fails when the repository and this file drift, so a reword is a new question set with a new id rather than an edit to this one.
Paired with the separately frozen program-selection-v3 suite. Historical v1 and v2 rows keep their own questions and suites.

program.instructions: Which program does this request ask this machine to run? Almost every request asks for none: a question to answer, an instruction to follow, a remark to reply to. Answer none unless the request asks for the work one of the other options describes.

criteria.none: This request asks for no program. It is an ordinary turn - a question, an instruction, or a remark - and the agent answers it itself.
criteria.answer-question: Answers a question about the repository from its own contents.
criteria.burn-down: Runs one delegated session per item of the work list this checkout carries (.coder/work-list.json), each in a worktree of its own, and keeps every worktree for review.
criteria.delegate-fan-out: Runs one delegated session per task, in parallel.
criteria.review-runs: Answers a question about Terminal-Bench runs from the Gym's records, with checked citations.
